minutes.headline: ZBA continued the Mansell ground-mount solar hearing to June 14 and conditionally approved Embers Pizza's patio expansion.
minutes.summary: The board heard a request for a dimensional variation for an 8 kW ground-mount solar array placed three feet from a side line. Members asked for a scaled plan, a shading diagram, a screening plan and a Conservation determination, so the hearing was continued. The board then heard the Embers Pizza request to expand its outdoor patio and approved it, conditioned on a certified plot plan showing the property lines.

public_comment.topic: A neighbor said she supports clean energy but worries a ground array in the neighborhood would hurt property values and set a precedent; she suggested a roof mount.

votes.motion: Continue the Mansell solar hearing until more detailed plans are provided, to June 14 at 7:30.
Approve the Embers Pizza patio special permit contingent on a certified plot plan showing the structure in relation to the lot lines.

budget_items.what_was_said: The applicant said the patio build would cost him roughly this amount and he does not want to over-excavate.

decisions.decision: Mansell solar hearing continued to June 14 at 7:30, with applicants to bring a shading diagram, screening plan, scaled plot plan and a Conservation determination.
Embers Pizza applicant chose to have the permit approved with a condition, giving two years to exercise it, rather than continuing or withdrawing.
The secretary will prepare the decision and the applicant will contact the Planning Board office about getting on its agenda.

what_happened.line: The board continued the Mansell ground-mount solar hearing to June 14 at 7:30, pending more detailed plans.
Applicants were told to bring a scaled plot plan, a shading diagram, a screening plan and a Conservation determination.
On the Embers Pizza patio expansion, the applicant chose approval with a condition, with two years to exercise the permit.
The motion to approve the patio permit, contingent on a certified plot plan showing the lot lines, was voted, but the outcome is not audible in the recording.
The secretary will prepare the decision, and the applicant will contact the Planning Board office about its agenda.

why_it_matters: A ground-mounted solar array close to a side line raises setback, shading and screening questions for neighbors, and the board has not yet ruled on the variation.
The Embers Pizza patio approval, if the vote is confirmed in the written decision, depends on a certified plot plan showing the property lines.
